title: Finance and Corporate Services Committee - September 14, 2026

items.title: Commencement

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Belmont Village Business Improvement Area (BIA) Snow Removal Service, DSD-2026-301
notes:
The Committee considered Development Services Department report DSD-2026-301, dated September 14, 2026, recommending a new special service for snow removal for a portion of the Bellmont Village business improvement area (BIA); that the draft bylaw be presented to Council for endorsement, and that the annual levy rate for special snow removal service be determined through the annual budget process. 

Councillor S. Davey noted that staff have advised there was a clerical error in the By-law as attached to the agenda this date and requested an amendment to Section 3.3 of the By-law to reflect the following: “The Special Levy shall be calculated annually, or on such other basis as otherwise allowed from time to time, having regard to the estimated or actual net cost of the Snow Removal Special Service. It will be based on the cost per linear metre of frontage allocated proportionately among all Benefiting Properties according to their respective frontage lengths.”

motions.item_title: Belmont Village Business Improvement Area (BIA) Snow Removal Service, DSD-2026-301
motions.text: it was resolved: "That Option 3, as described in Development Services Department report DSD-2026-301, be approved as a new special service for snow removal for a portion of the Belmont Village Business Improvement Area (BIA); and, That the draft bylaw attached to report DSD-2026-301 and as amended this date, being a bylaw to establish a special service and special service area, in accordance with the Ontario Municipal Act, be approved; and further, That the annual levy rate for special snow removal service be determined through the annual budget process."
